name: What is the difference between organic search and paid Google Ads for luxury real estate?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between organic search and paid Google Ads for luxury real estate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Organic search results are achieved through Search Engine Optimization (SEO) and appear naturally based on content relevance and authority, typically taking longer to rank. Paid Google Ads, on the other hand, offer immediate visibility by appearing at the top of search results for specific keywords through a bidding system. While SEO builds long-term presence, Google Ads provides instant exposure for urgent luxury listings in competitive markets like South Beach or Brickell, offering a practical tradeoff between speed and sustained organic growth.
acceptedAnswer.description: Organic search relies on long-term SEO for natural rankings, while paid Google Ads provide immediate top-of-page visibility through bidding, offering a tradeoff between speed and sustained presence.
